content.title: 3 Value Stocks with Questionable Fundamentals
content.summary: Value stocks typically trade at discounts to the broader market, offering patient investors the opportunity to buy businesses when they’re out of favor. The key risk, however, is that these stocks are usually cheap for a reason – five cents for a piece of fruit may seem like a great deal until you find out it’s rotten.

content.title: 3 Consumer Stocks with Questionable Fundamentals
content.summary: Consumer staples stocks are solid insurance policies in frothy markets ripe for corrections. But they’re also double-edged swords as they often lag in booming conditions, and this pattern has persisted recently. Over the past six months, the industry has recorded a loss of 7.2%, a far cry from the S&P 500’s 22.6% ascent.

content.title: Utz (UTZ) Margin Gains Reinforce Premium Valuation Narrative Despite Slower Revenue Growth
content.summary: Utz Brands (UTZ) posted another quarter of improved profitability, as net profit margins climbed to 1.3% from 0.3% a year ago. Annual earnings growth hit an impressive 371.9%, easily outpacing the company’s 5-year average of 61% per year. With revenue forecast to grow at just 2.8% per year, which is well below the broader US market’s 10.3%, investors are watching closely to see if strong margin gains can continue as Utz trades at a premium yet sits below its estimated fair value.
